description: The following text is about the payor process and starts with the transmission to the vendor accounting department. Once the sending to the vendor accounting department occurs, creating a receiving report needs to be done. After creating a receiving report, one or more of the following paths should be executed: verifying that all documents have been amended and collecting the invoice of vendors. Afterwards, storing should be done in the paid invoice file. The process is now complete.

fields.trigger_step: transmission to the vendor accounting department

fields.completion_step: storing should be done in the paid invoice file
